description: This Python source file defines an output module for uploading CloudZero billing data in the CBF (CloudBillingFormat) format to CloudZero's AnyCost API. It includes a class `CloudZeroStreamer` responsible for batching, timestamp handling, timezone conversion, and API communication for daily billing data uploads.

classes.name: CloudZeroStreamer
classes.description: A class responsible for streaming CBF data to CloudZero's AnyCost API, handling batching by date, timezone conversion, and API communication with error handling.

methods.name: __init__(self, api_key: str, connection_id: str, user_timezone: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Initializes the CloudZeroStreamer with API key, connection ID, and optional user timezone, setting up connection parameters and timezone info.

methods.name: None send_batched(self, data: pl.DataFrame, operation: str = "replace_hourly")
methods.description: Executes batching of input DataFrame by date, converts timestamps, and sends each batch to the CloudZero API.

methods.name: dict[str,pl.DataFrame] _group_by_date(self, data: pl.DataFrame)
methods.description: Groups the input DataFrame rows by date after converting 'time/usage_start' to UTC and correct date format.

methods.name: datetime _parse_and_convert_timestamp(self, timestamp_str: str)
methods.description: Parses timestamp strings, handles different ISO8601 formats, applies timezone conversions, and returns a UTC datetime object.

methods.name: None _send_daily_batch(self, batch_date: str, batch_data: pl.DataFrame, operation: str)
methods.description: Sends an individual daily batch of data to the CloudZero API, handling HTTP request and response, with error handling.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] _prepare_batch_payload(self, batch_date: str, batch_data: pl.DataFrame, operation: str)
methods.description: Prepares API payload including the formatted date, operation, and list of data records in CloudZero's required format.

methods.name: Optional[dict[str,Any]] _convert_cbf_to_api_format(self, row: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a DataFrame row into CloudZero's API data format, formatting numeric values and timestamps appropriately.

methods.name: str _ensure_utc_timestamp(self, timestamp_str: str)
methods.description: Ensures the timestamp string is in UTC ISO format, converting if necessary.
